evidence.feed_summary: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson did not start the second half of Sunday's game vs. the Titans. He's officially questionable to return with an ankle injury. Jackson is on the sidelines without his helmet, with Baltimore up 24-7. QB Tyler Hunter has replaced him. We'll update Jackson's status when we know more.

Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot) is active for today’s game vs. the Seahawks. He was listed as questionable after only getting in limited practices on Wednesday and Friday. But NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport said this morning that McConkey’s foot injury is not as serious as the rib injury he suffered in Week 1.

editorial.headline: Mack Hollins Leaves With Calf Injury
editorial.thread_title: [NE] Mack Hollins Leaves With Calf Injury

evidence.feed_summary: Patriots WR Mack Hollins injured his calf in the third quarter of Sunday's game vs. the Bills and is questionable to return. His absence leaves Romeo Doubs, Demario Douglas, and Kyle Williams as New England's top 3 WRs.
evidence.original_title: Mack Hollins Leaves With Calf Injury

evidence.feed_summary: 49ers WR Mike Evans (ribs) is active for today’s game vs. the Broncos. TE George Kittle revealed earlier this week that Evans is dealing with fractured ribs. He’s at risk of playing limited snaps and/or getting knocked out of this game early. Evans would be a risky fantasy start this week.

Chiefs WR Rashee Rice injured his hamstring in the first quarter of Sunday's game vs. the Raiders. He pulled up at the end of a catch and headed straight to the sidelines. We'll update Rice's status when we know more.

editorial.headline: Jameis Winston buys another Giants start with 250 yards and 3 TDs
editorial.thread_title: [NYG] Jameis Winston buys another Giants start with 250 yards and 3 TDs

evidence.feed_summary: After struggling since taking over for the injured QB Jaxson Dart, Winston turned in his best performance of the season. He completed 18 of his 29 pass attempts for 250 yards and 3 TDs along with 2 INTs in a 36-24 win over the Cardinals. It’s Winston’s first 3 passing TD game since Week 13 of 2024.
